metadata.question: In January 2021, did Nambia experience over 7 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Namibia (approximate bounding box or country boundary) - Date: January 2021 - Dataset: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) is the standard for global rainfall analysis. It provides monthly and daily precipitation data. - Alternative: MERRA-2 or TRMM if CHIRPS fails 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation data; CHIRPS is already a processed, gap-filled product - Need to check data validity and ensure pixels are available over Namibia 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - 7 inches = ~177.8 mm - Check if mean rainfall across Namibia in January 2021 is > 177.8 mm - If result is None/NaN or collection is empty, return C1/C3 - If valid pixels exist but result is 0 or valid number, return A (yes, >7 inches) or B (no, ≤7 inches) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Namibia geometry const namibia = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/administrative_boundaries_open/1.0/countries') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Namibia')); const namibiaGeom = namibia.geometry(); // 2. Acquire CHIRPS precipitation data for January 2021 const startDate = '2021-01-01'; const endDate = '2021-01-31'; const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/MONTHLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(namibiaGeom); const size = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Images in Jan 2021: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log('No CHIRPS data found for January 2021 over Namibia.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Get the precipitation image for January 2021 const precip = chirps.first(); // 4. Calculate mean rainfall over Namibia const precipStats = precip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: namibiaGeom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanRainfall = precipStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean Rainfall in Jan 2021: ${meanRainfall} mm`); // Check for valid pixel count const pixelCount = precip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: namibiaGeom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); // 5. Validation & Answer if (meanRainfall === null || isNaN(meanRainfall)) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } const sevenInchesInMm = 7 * 25.4; // 177.8 mm if (meanRainfall > sevenInchesInMm) { console.log(`Over 7 inches (${sevenInchesInMm.toFixed(1)} mm): Yes (${meanRainfall.toFixed(1)} mm)`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Over 7 inches (${sevenInchesInMm.toFixed(1)} mm): No (${meanRainfall.toFixed(1)} mm)`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
